headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of September 22, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 28.85%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 14.10%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 14.75%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark. The top portfolio, 'Random A', achieved a remarkable return of 48.36%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 11.23%, highlighting a clear distinction in performance across the portfolio set. This relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
